title: Performance Review Policy
text: Employees receive formal performance reviews annually.

title: Dress Code Policy
text: Employees are expected to dress in business casual attire.

title: Warranty Policy
text: Products are covered under warranty for one year.

title: Account Management Policy
text: Accounts must be reviewed quarterly.

title: Anti-Harassment Policy
text: Harassment of any kind is not tolerated.

title: Recognition Program Policy
text: Employees may nominate peers for recognition awards.

title: Software Installation Policy
text: Only approved software may be installed on company devices.

title: Workplace Accommodation Policy
text: Employees may request reasonable accommodations.

title: Data Privacy Policy
text: Employees must protect customer data and follow privacy regulations.

title: Work From Abroad Policy
text: Employees may work abroad for up to 30 days with approval.

title: File Naming Policy
text: Files must follow naming conventions for easy retrieval.

title: Company Vehicle Policy
text: Use of company vehicles must be logged and approved.

title: Onboarding Policy
text: New hires must complete onboarding within their first week.

title: Legal Hold Policy
text: Legal holds must be applied to relevant documents.

title: Budget Planning Policy
text: Departments must submit budgets by Q4.

title: Holiday Schedule Policy
text: Company holidays are published annually and observed accordingly.

title: Support Ticket Policy
text: Support tickets must be resolved within SLA.

title: Supplier Evaluation Policy
text: Suppliers must be evaluated annually.

title: Parking Policy
text: Parking spaces are assigned and must be used accordingly.

title: Equal Opportunity Policy
text: The company is committed to equal opportunity employment.

title: Customer Interaction Policy
text: Employees must maintain professionalism in all customer interactions.

title: Customer Feedback Policy
text: Customer feedback must be logged and reviewed.

title: Marketing Approval Policy
text: Marketing materials must be approved before release.

title: Remote Work Policy
text: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.

title: Code of Conduct
text: All employees must adhere to professional behavior standards.

title: Meeting Room Booking Policy
text: Meeting rooms must be booked in advance using the portal.

title: Internal Communication Policy
text: Use company channels for internal communication.

title: Mobile Device Policy
text: Employees may request company-issued mobile devices for work.

title: Training Reimbursement Policy
text: Employees may be reimbursed for approved external training.

title: Client Gift Policy
text: Client gifts must comply with company guidelines.

title: Campaign Review Policy
text: Marketing campaigns must be reviewed quarterly.

title: Employee Referral Policy
text: Employees may refer candidates for open positions.

title: Offer Letter Policy
text: Offer letters must follow approved templates.

title: Work Anniversary Recognition Policy
text: Employees are recognized on their work anniversaries.

title: Conflict of Interest Policy
text: Employees must disclose any potential conflicts of interest.

title: Business Continuity Policy
text: Departments must maintain business continuity plans.

title: System Downtime Policy
text: Planned downtimes are communicated in advance.

title: Hardware Upgrade Policy
text: Hardware upgrades must be requested through IT.

title: Exit Interview Policy
text: Departing employees are encouraged to participate in an exit interview.

title: Security Incident Policy
text: Security incidents must be reported immediately.

title: Promotion Policy
text: Promotions are based on performance and business needs.

title: Sales Incentive Policy
text: Sales incentives must be documented and approved.

title: Probation Period Policy
text: New hires are subject to a 90-day probation period.

title: Mentorship Program Policy
text: Employees may participate in the mentorship program.

title: Public Speaking Policy
text: Employees must get approval before public speaking engagements.

title: Sustainability Policy
text: Departments should consider sustainability in operations.

title: Remote Access Policy
text: Remote access must use secure VPN connections.

title: Incident Response Policy
text: Incident response procedures must be followed during disruptions.

title: Inventory Management Policy
text: Inventory must be tracked and reconciled monthly.

title: Asset Disposal Policy
text: IT assets must be disposed of securely.

title: Office Access Policy
text: Access badges must be worn and not shared.

title: Product Return Policy
text: Returns must follow the documented return process.

title: Email Signature Policy
text: All employees must use the approved email signature format.

title: Cloud Storage Policy
text: Use approved cloud storage for company documents.

title: Shipping Policy
text: Shipping must use approved carriers.

title: Social Media Policy
text: Employees must not disclose confidential information on social media.

title: Remote Meeting Policy
text: Remote meetings should use approved video conferencing tools.

title: Interview Panel Policy
text: Interview panels must include diverse representation.

title: Expense Approval Policy
text: All expenses over $500 require prior approval from Finance.

title: Customer Onboarding Policy
text: New customers must complete onboarding steps.

title: Document Retention Policy
text: Documents must be retained according to legal requirements.

title: Cybersecurity Awareness Policy
text: Employees must complete annual cybersecurity training.

title: Corporate Card Policy
text: Corporate card usage must comply with expense guidelines.

title: Flexible Hours Policy
text: Employees may adjust work hours with manager approval.

title: Sick Leave Policy
text: Employees accrue sick leave monthly for personal or family illness.

title: Content Publishing Policy
text: Content must be reviewed before publishing.

title: Home Office Equipment Policy
text: Employees may request ergonomic equipment for remote work.

title: Laptop Usage Policy
text: Company laptops must be used for business purposes only.

title: Procurement Policy
text: All purchases must follow the procurement process.

title: Bereavement Leave Policy
text: Employees may take up to 5 days of bereavement leave.

title: Disaster Recovery Policy
text: IT must maintain disaster recovery protocols.

title: Petty Cash Policy
text: Petty cash usage must be documented and reconciled monthly.

title: Brand Guidelines Policy
text: All materials must follow brand guidelines.

title: Contract Review Policy
text: Contracts must be reviewed by Legal before signing.

title: Parental Leave Policy
text: Eligible employees may take up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave.

title: Background Check Policy
text: All new hires must pass background checks.

title: Tuition Assistance Policy
text: Employees may apply for tuition assistance for approved programs.

title: Internet Usage Policy
text: Company internet should be used for work-related activities only.

title: Whistleblower Policy
text: Employees may report unethical behavior anonymously.

title: Exit Clearance Policy
text: Departing employees must complete exit clearance.

title: Vendor Management Policy
text: Vendors must be approved and reviewed annually.

title: Quality Assurance Policy
text: Products must pass quality checks before release.

title: Conference Attendance Policy
text: Employees may attend conferences with prior approval.

title: Media Contact Policy
text: Only authorized employees may speak to the media.

title: Diversity and Inclusion Policy
text: The company promotes a diverse and inclusive workplace.

title: Workplace Safety Policy
text: Employees must follow safety procedures and report hazards.

title: Workplace Cleanliness Policy
text: Employees are responsible for maintaining clean workspaces.

title: Helpdesk Ticket Policy
text: All IT issues must be submitted via helpdesk ticket.

title: Meeting Etiquette Policy
text: Meetings should start on time and follow an agenda.

title: Lead Management Policy
text: Sales leads must be tracked in the CRM.

title: IT Asset Management Policy
text: All IT assets must be tracked and returned upon exit.

title: Password Policy
text: Passwords must be changed every 90 days and meet complexity requirements.

title: Travel Reimbursement Policy
text: Employees must submit receipts for travel expenses within 30 days.

title: Press Release Policy
text: Press releases must be approved by Marketing and Legal.

title: Vacation Policy
text: Employees receive 15 vacation days per year. Unused days may roll over.

title: Escalation Policy
text: Customer issues must follow the escalation process.

title: Job Posting Policy
text: All internal job postings are listed on the company portal.

title: Company Property Policy
text: Employees must return company property upon exit.
